slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the number of fighter jets required to train one pilot during a single year?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks the per-pilot/per-jet training capacity in a year; the simulator's answer establishes that one jet trains five pilots per year.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: No question asks how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise addresses the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the fighter jets produced in a given year available for pilot training in that same year, or do they become available for training only in the following year?
slot_scores.rationale: Touches the timing of when training can use jets and later how Year 1/Year 2 pilots are counted, but does not explicitly ask when the training program starts or how many years it lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: that pilot training occurs in Year 1 and Year 2, i.e., starts in Year 1 and spans the two-year horizon
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the training start year or duration; it only asked related availability/carry-over and summation questions, then modeled x1 and x2 as training allocations in Year 1 and Year 2.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H1 was resolved, but H3 remained only partially addressed when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL, and no explicit confirmation of training start/duration was obtained.

summary: The agent recovered the key per-jet training capacity and clarified objective/count definition, but it did not fully clarify the training start/duration and never addressed pilot-to-combat-jet mapping; it stopped with a partially unresolved P1 slot.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
